title: Global Convergence of the Gursky-Malchiodi $Q$-curvature Flow
summary: In their seminal work, Gursky and Malchiodi introduced a non-local conformal flow in dimensions $n \geq 5$ to resolve the constant $Q$-curvature problem. They proved sequential convergence of the flow for initial metrics with positive scalar curvature and $Q$-curvature, provided the energy was sufficiently small. In this paper, we prove the global convergence of the flow for arbitrary initial energy under the same positivity assumptions by establishing a non-local version of the Łojasiewicz-Simon inequality for the Paneitz-Sobolev quotient along the flow.
